description: Points the customer's links subdomain (for example links.example.com) to OutboundPro's tracking host with a DNS-only CNAME (no proxy) and publishes OutboundPro's ownership proof (TXT _outboundpro.<subdomain> = outboundpro-verify=<token>). OutboundPro only starts using the subdomain after it finds that TXT with the token of the current registration, so a CNAME left behind after a deletion can never be claimed by another account. The TLS certificate for that subdomain is issued on OutboundPro's side. Apply with the host parameter set to the links subdomain.
variableDescription: %verify%: OutboundPro's ownership proof token for this registration (32 URL-safe characters, new on every registration), published as outboundpro-verify=%verify%.
